This project uses FFmpeg libraries (libavcodec, libavformat, libavutil, libswscale,
libswresample) in their shared library (DLL) form under the GNU Lesser General
Public License version 2.1 or later.

FFmpeg is copyright (c) the FFmpeg developers.
https://ffmpeg.org/

The full text of the LGPL v2.1 is available at:
https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/lgpl-2.1.html

UzEngine links dynamically to FFmpeg shared libraries (.dll) and does not
modify or distribute FFmpeg source code. Per LGPL v2.1 Section 6, dynamic
linking to LGPL libraries does not impose LGPL obligations on the application.
